world.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
world.description: Mokha's capture would bring the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait waterway, a key shipping route.

world.title: Five killed and 67 injured in Russian strike on shopping centre, Ukraine says
world.description: The attack in Pavlohrad city centre was the third Russian strike on a mall within days, local media report.

world.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows

world.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
world.description: The paper said it stood by its reporting, after publishing extracts from a book where the claim appears.

world.title: Man jailed after threatening to kill son's teacher in French village
world.description: The father had threatened to behead a female primary school teacher near Toulouse.

world.title: Coach crash kills several people in Swiss Alps
world.description: The tourist coach was carrying dozens of Dutch passengers when it overturned in the south-eastern Swiss Alps.

world.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
world.description: Officials say there was a stampede as they fled a fire that engulfed two schools in the eastern rebel-held city of Bukavu.

world.title: Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes up for auction
world.description: Auction house Sotheby's expects the dress to sell for up to $300,000 (£220,000) when it goes under the hammer on 9 December.

world.title: Can Trump really pay $5,000 to every American adult?
world.description: Analysts question if the US president's election year offer is workable, legal or affordable.

world.title: Apple's new boss starts with big gamble on £1,999 first folding iPhone
world.description: Apple showed off at an event the first major design change to the iPhone in almost 20 years.

world.title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
world.description: Of the 42 people on board, 17 were were evacuated, CCTV reports.

world.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
world.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

world.title: Ukraine's fortress cities under fire as Russia bids to seize rest of Donbas

US.title: Why Houthi military gains in Yemen may further increase gas prices

US.title: Hong Kong court sentences 3 Tiananmen vigil organizers to prison
US.description: The activists were sentenced to about 5 to 7 years in prison in a case widely seen as a barometer of the city's eroding freedoms as Beijing clamps down on dissent.

US.title: Iran-backed Houthi rebels seize strategic Red Sea port in Yemen
US.description: The rebel group took over Yemen's port of Mokha, an area vital to controlling shipping through the Red Sea, Houthi and Yemeni officials said. Mokha is about 50 miles from the Bab el-Mandeb Strait

US.title: This summer was hot. August shattered global heat records

US.title: Lawsuit challenges intimidation of DHS observers across the country

US.title: A fossil feather from the age of dinosaurs may explain why only some birds survived

US.title: How the WNBA became a political prop in the culture wars
US.description: Sports journalist Sabreena Merchant says culture war issues related to race and trans athletes threaten to overshadow exceptional play on the WNBA court.

US.title: Barbara Keating died in the 9/11 attack. She's finally being laid to rest
US.description: Barbara Keating died aboard one of the planes that hijackers slammed into the World Trade Center. Her remains were finally identified last year, and her family is gathering for a long-delayed funeral.

US.title: Elon Musk threatens to sue over Gibney documentary's "space lasers" claim
US.description: The tech billionaire's attorney has put documentarian Alex Gibney and his production company on legal notice, claiming the Oscar-winning director defamed Musk in his nearly four-hour documentary.

US.title: 'I've never seen anything like this' -- A U.S. doctor treats Ebola's youngest victims
US.description: Dr. Rupa Narra is a U.S. pediatrician who arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo to help care for stricken children. Nothing could have prepared her for what she'd face.
